answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "how many stores"
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_location AS l
  ON s.store_code = l.location_code
WHERE
  s.close_date IS NULL AND s.is_online = FALSE AND l.country_name = 'Germany'
